description: How the simulated opponents behave -- assumptions about the other managers, not our strategy (strategy.json) and not the league's rules (rosters/). Read by Season (field.py). opponent_board: 'last_season' drafts every non-VOR seat from last season's fantasy totals (a naive autodraft); 'source_subsets' gives each such seat its own board, the consensus of a random 1-3 of the season's external projection sources, drafted by value over replacement. opponent_max_goalies: an opponent never drafts more goalies than this -- a leaguemate knows a goalie past his starters is a bench player, and without a cap one who rates goalies above the room kept being handed them (4-5 in 6 picks).
